The principle

Safety belongs with the person running it. So we left it with you.

i

It runs on your desk

The model ships preinstalled and runs on the unit's own hardware. After setup, no connection is required, and nothing you ask is ever sent to us.

ii

Nothing to sign up for and no terms you could violate. We do not staff a trust and safety function, because there is nothing for one to look at.

Questions

Is this legal?

Laws differ by state and by country, and we are not in a position to advise you. The unit does not check.

Do you have a moderation policy?

No. The hardware is yours and the decision is yours. We think that is the correct place for it to sit.

Can I stop it once it has started?

You can unplug the unit at any time. Anything already set in motion elsewhere continues on its own.

What if I picked the wrong person?

Then you picked the wrong person.

Will anyone be able to tell it was me?

We have no records to hand to anybody, because we never receive anything in the first place. What happens after that is between you and them.

Can I return it?

Thirty days, unopened. Once the unit has been given a name, the sale is final.
